subject: ela
intro: Pick the central ideas or objective summary.

items.prompt:
Read.

Exercise strengthens the body and improves mood.

The two central ideas involve:
A) body and mind
B) food and sleep
C) only muscles

An OBJECTIVE summary:
A) includes your opinion
B) states key points without opinion
C) is very long
items.answer: B) states key points without opinion

solution.answer: B) states key points without opinion

items.prompt:
A central idea is supported by:
A) details and evidence
B) the cover
C) the page number

steps: Details support ideas. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Read.

The internet connects people worldwide, but it also spreads misinformation quickly.

The two central ideas are that the internet:
A) connects people and spreads misinformation
B) is only good
C) is only bad
items.answer: A) connects people and spreads misinformation

solution.answer: A) connects people and spreads misinformation

items.prompt:
Which is an OBJECTIVE summary?
A) The amazing internet is the best thing ever, connecting people.
B) The internet connects people but also spreads misinformation.
C) I love the internet.
items.answer: B) The internet connects people but also spreads misinformation.

solution.answer: B) The internet connects people but also spreads misinformation.

items.prompt:
A central idea DEVELOPS:
A) only in the title
B) gradually, supported by details across the text
C) never
items.answer: B) gradually, supported by details across the text

steps: Builds over the text. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) gradually, supported by details across the text

items.prompt:
Read.

Antibiotics have saved millions of lives. However, overusing them has caused some bacteria to become resistant, making infections harder to treat.

The two central ideas are that antibiotics:
A) are useless
B) save lives, but overuse creates resistant bacteria
C) should never be used
items.answer: B) save lives, but overuse creates resistant bacteria

solution.answer: B) save lives, but overuse creates resistant bacteria

items.prompt:
Which sentence does NOT belong in an objective summary?
A) Solar power produces no emissions while running.
B) Solar power is clearly the only smart choice anyone should ever make.
C) Installing solar panels can be expensive.
items.answer: B) Solar power is clearly the only smart choice anyone should ever make.

solution.answer: B) Solar power is clearly the only smart choice anyone should ever make.
